summary.headline: Tips Music Q4 FY26 revenue rose 32% YoY to INR103.9 crore and PAT 93% to INR59 crore; management targets 20% top-line and 20% bottom-line growth in FY27.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 revenue was INR103.9 crore (+32% YoY), operating EBITDA INR76.9 crore (+106% YoY) and PAT INR59 crore (+93% YoY), with management saying there were no one-offs. For FY26, revenue was INR375.5 crore (+21%) and PAT INR216.6 crore (+30%), and the company distributed INR166 crore in dividends. Digital was about 70% of FY26 revenue and non-digital about 30%, with brand publishing and public performance cited as growth contributors. Content cost fell to about 15.8% of revenue as a film's music release slipped from Q4 to June 2026. Management guided to 20% top-line and 20% bottom-line growth for FY27 and declined to raise that target further.

segments.name: Digital (incl. YouTube, subscriptions)
segments.commentary: About 70% of FY26 revenue; management said a couple of platform closures were a headwind at the start of the year. YouTube long-form views grew as expected while YouTube Shorts views declined, which management called non-material to revenue.

segments.name: Non-digital (publishing, public performance, brand)
segments.commentary: About 30% of FY26 revenue; brand publishing and public performance were cited as the main contributors, and the Q4 non-digital share rose versus earlier quarters.

guidance_outlook: FY27 target of 20% top-line and 20% bottom-line growth; management declined to raise it to 30%, saying it will review after one or two quarters.
Content spend guided at roughly 20% to 25% of top-line for FY27 (analyst figure confirmed by management).
Management said content cost could reach INR80 crore to INR90 crore in FY27, versus about INR60 crore in FY26 and INR70 crore to INR71 crore in FY25.
Two films, Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai and Main Vaapas Aaunga, are slated for theatrical release on 22 May and 12 June 2026; their music costs will be expensed in Q1 FY27 on release.
YouTube Shorts deal renewal is due around June 2026; negotiations were expected to start at end-April or early May 2026. Management said the view decline does not affect the renewal.
capex_capacity: Content slate for FY27 is in investor presentation Slide 8; management cited a David Dhawan film and an Imtiaz Ali and A.R. Rahman project.
Acquired Kutchchi Music (Gujarati label) with about 4,000 songs in roughly Q2 FY26 (July-August 2025).
Public performance licences are now available online, which management expects to drive growth.
Management is cautious on acquisitions because of high valuations.
demand_pricing: Q4 FY26 release of 66 new songs (47 film, 19 non-film), with a focus on quality over quantity.
YouTube subscribers at 153 million; a catalogue song on Instagram reached 3 billion views and another 1.5 billion.
Management attributed the growth to the repertoire, with several catalogue songs trending across Instagram, YouTube and Spotify.
Public performance industry is about INR500 crore; management expects it to reach at least INR3,000 crore in about three years (over 50% CAGR).
Management said bundling with telecom packs gives lower payouts and prefers pure-play music platforms.
The company said the Warner Chappell India publishing setup is positive; it already works with Sony Publishing.
Management said the industry is growing at about 8%, against the company's 20% to 25%; the call attributed the gap to repertoire strength and streaming growth.

qa_highlights.question: What drove the 32% Q4 growth, and were there any one-offs?
qa_highlights.answer: Management credited the 90s repertoire and said there were no one-offs or adjustments; all revenue was recurring.

qa_highlights.question: Why did YouTube Shorts views decline, and does it affect the June 2026 renewal?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the decline is normal, with viral spikes causing peaks, and sees no material impact on renewal. Negotiations start at the end of April or early May 2026, and no replacement has been named for Hari Nair.

qa_highlights.question: Why did content cost fall to 15.8% of revenue versus 23% last year, against an 18% target?
qa_highlights.answer: A film, Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai, had its music moved from January to June 2026, delaying content cost. Costs will be expensed when released in Q1 FY27.

qa_highlights.question: Will employee costs stay at the Q4 level?
qa_highlights.answer: No; the Q4 increase reflects the annual increment provision, and cost should return to Q2 and Q3 run rates.

qa_highlights.question: What is paid subscription's share of revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Paid subscription is 10% to 15% of digital revenue, up from about 10% to 12% last year, and it is growing at 30% to 40% CAGR.

qa_highlights.question: Are there any advances or provisions to Tips Films in the balance sheet?
qa_highlights.answer: The CFO declined to give details, but said the terms are arm's length. He said the album cost is fully expensed on release and nothing is carried on the balance sheet.

qa_highlights.question: Why are the FY27 growth targets only 20%, and will the company raise them?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it does not want to over-promise and will revisit after one or two quarters.

qa_highlights.question: Why did revenue jump, and is the non-digital base in Q4 sustainable?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Q1 is seasonally low and Q3 and Q4 are stronger; publishing, public performance and brand revenue are expected to continue.

risks_watch: YouTube Shorts renewal in June 2026 after the departure of Hari Nair, with no replacement yet named.
Content cost is set to rise to INR80 crore to INR90 crore in FY27, which could pressure margins if the Q1 film releases underperform.
Digital share fell in Q4 and the mix relies on non-digital growth; management did not give the non-digital breakdown.
Related-party dealings with Tips Films; the CFO declined to give details of advances or liabilities.
Management says the music market is overvalued and will cool, which could limit acquisitions.
Management declined to disclose YouTube or Warner revenue split.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the repertoire and the FY27 20% target, but evasive on specifics such as the revenue split, Warner and YouTube terms, the Tips Films related-party balances and the Shorts renewal. Management also took a deliberately cautious line on raising guidance.
